articles.title: Scientists reveal what sparkling water really does to your teeth

Importantly, acidity remained above the level associated with enamel damage.

articles.title: Eating within 8 hours may help keep the aging brain sharp
articles.summary: Eating within a shorter daily window may help protect certain thinking skills as people age. In a small six-month trial, older women who limited eating to about 8 to 9 hours a day performed better on planning and problem-solving tests than those who ate over 12 hours. Both groups lost similar amounts of weight, hinting that when people eat could matter in addition to how much they eat.

Анализ данных о 26 400 секвоях показал, что деревья в районах, подвергавшихся намеренным выжиганиям, выживали почти в четыре раза чаще. Исследователи оценивают, что такие пожары предотвратили около 1900 гибель деревьев, и их широкое применение могло бы спасти еще тысячи.
articles.original_description: Giant sequoias are built to withstand ordinary fires, but recent extreme wildfires killed thousands of trees that had survived for centuries or even millennia. Researchers estimate the controlled fires prevented about 1,900 deaths and could have saved thousands more if used across every grove.

articles.title: Hidden genetic diversity helped inbred brown tree snakes conquer guam
articles.summary: A notorious snake invasion that devastated Guam’s native birds may have succeeded because the reptiles carried hidden genetic advantages. Using advanced long-read DNA sequencing, researchers uncovered more than 19,000 large genetic differences in brown tree snakes, many concentrated in genes tied to immunity and smell. This overlooked diversity may have helped a population founded by only a few snakes survive inbreeding, adapt to a new environment, and multiply to extraordinary densities.
